We own, operate, acquire and selectively develop apartment communities located in the southeast, southwest and mid-atlantic regions of the united states. As of december 31, 2018, we maintained full or partial ownership of apartment communities and commercial properties across 17 states and the district of columbia, summarized as follows:.

|---|---|---|

| Unconsolidated | 1 | 269 |
| Total | 304 | 100,864 |

| Consolidated | 4 | 260,000 |

Maa and maalp were formed in tennessee in 1993. As of december 31, 2018, we had 2508 full- time employees and 44 part-time employees..

- **Total Units**: 100,864 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Consolidated Units**: 100,595 (Source: documents/report.md)

## Percentage Calculation

The percentage of unconsolidated units among the total units is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Unconsolidated Units}}{\text{Total Units}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{269}{100,864} \right) \times 100 \approx 0.27\% \]

# MAA Fiscal 2018 Units

- **Unconsolidated Units**: 269 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total Units**: 100,864 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Consolidated Units**: 100,595 (Source: documents/report.md)

## Percentage Calculation

The percentage of unconsolidated units among the total units is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Unconsolidated Units}}{\text{Total Units}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{269}{100,864} \right) \times 100 \approx 0.27\% \]
